title: Forgified Core
description: Created for modpack makers, combines all the features of OptiFine and good performance. Supports (Neo)Forge and Fabric mods at the same time.
body:
# <center>⚡Forgified Core⚡</center>

### <center>The ultimate foundation for modern (Neo)Forge modpacks.</center>

**Forgified Core** is a lightweight **client-side** modpack focused on **performance**, **visual improvements**, and **maximum compatibility**. Instead of manually installing dozens of optimization, rendering and quality-of-life mods, it provides everything in one carefully configured package.

---

## 🚀 Performance

Experience smoother gameplay with a collection of modern optimization mods that improve:

- ✅ **Higher FPS**
- ✅ **Faster chunk loading**
- ✅ **Reduced memory usage**
- ✅ **Better CPU utilization**
- ✅ **Lower stuttering**
- ✅ **Improved rendering performance**

---

## 🎨 Graphics

Enjoy **OptiFine-like features** without using **OptiFine**.

Included features:

- 💡 **Dynamic Lights**
- 🌈 **Shaders Support**
- 🧩 **Connected Textures**
- 🔍 **Zoom**
- ☁️ **Better Sky**
- 🌿 **Better Grass**
- ✨ **Better Particles**
- 🖥️ **Enhanced GUI**

---

## 🎭 Animations

Modpack includes:

- **Fresh Animations**
- **Fresh Animations: Player Extension**
- **Just Expressions x FA: Player Extension**

bringing Minecraft mobs and the player to life while keeping the vanilla style.

---

## 🔧 Compatibility

**Forgified Core** uses:

- **Sinytra Connector**
- **Forgified Fabric API**

allowing a huge number of **Fabric mods to work alongside (Neo)Forge mods**.

---

## 🌐 Multiplayer

**Forgified Core** is a **client-side** modpack.

You can join vanilla servers without requiring the modpack on the server.\
*(unless the server itself uses additional gameplay mods)*

---

## 📦 Perfect for Modpack Creators

**Forgified Core** isn't just another optimization modpack. It is designed to be a **solid foundation** for creating your own modpacks. Instead of spending hours choosing compatible optimization and rendering mods, you can immediately start adding gameplay content.

<center><sub>Created by Tapacywka with ❤️ for the Minecraft community</sub></center>
